messages:
iris_marketing: Heads up 1: we got the interview recording and the signed release from AltaCore. Need to lock final wording for the case study and social snippets by Mon EOD so we can align the paid-social calendar.

nick_growth: Great. I can draft 3 short social variations and one paid headline. Do we have the approved quote text from the customer or are we still editing?

tori_cs: AltaCore approved two quotes but asked to remove any revenue figures and to avoid naming internal vendor stacks. They also asked that the quote attribution be to 'S. Patel, Head of ML'. Signed release attached.

raj_pm: Perf details: our dedicated deployment improved token throughput ~2.8x in their steady-state runs. Latency p95 improved from ~420ms to ~170ms for their typical 1.2k token window. I'm compiling the mini-methods note for the appendix.

marco_design: I'll prepare a hero banner and a 2-slide product performance graphic. Which logo variant to use? AltaCore gave a horizontal and stacked option.

iris_marketing: Use the horizontal mark. Also plan to include a small "deployment type: Redwood Dedicated" badge. Confirm no proprietary details in the appendix.

legal_bot: Confirmed: remove vendor names and internal hostnames, redact any contract numbers. Customer release excludes mention of contract length or ARR. Must keep quote language verbatim as provided in the signed PDF.

nick_growth: Draft social lines: 1) "AltaCore speeds up LLM inference with Redwood Dedicated 1: 2.8x throughput" 2) "From pilot to production: AltaCore reduced p95 latency by ~60%" 3) "How AltaCore scaled real-time features without growing inference costs" Which one works? Need to avoid revenue/contract claims per legal.

tori_cs: Option 2 is safe if we say "reduced p95 latency by ~60%" since it's a performance stat. But legal wants exact quote wording kept, and they asked to avoid percent if they didn't explicitly approve it. We need to use the customer's approved quote only for attribution; stats can be included in a methods box if vetted. I'll ping the customer for explicit permission on the percent figure.

ops_bot: Reminder: sanitized artifacts must be stored under `s3://redwood-marketing/altacore/sanitized/2026-03-20/`. I'll auto-scan the PR for any S3 or internal hostnames.

marco_design: Uploaded draft assets to `design/marketing/altacore-case-v0.2.pdf`. Left space for the stat box and the pull quote.

iris_marketing: Customer replied: they approve the stat language "p95 latency reduced from ~420ms to ~170ms" but asked to soften throughput language to "nearly 3x throughput" rather than 2.8x. They also approved the final quote: "Redwood made our inference predictable and cost-effective." Attribution: S. Patel, Head of ML. Signed PDF attached.

nick_growth: Updated social options: A) "AltaCore reduces p95 latency from ~420ms to ~170ms with Redwood" B) "Nearly 3x inference throughput for AltaCore on Redwood Dedicated" C) "Redwood helped AltaCore make inference predictable and cost-effective" Which should be primary?

iris_marketing: Use C for the paid headline, A for organic, and B as an experiment in the paid set. Keep copy consistent with the approved quote.

raj_pm: I've added a short methods blurb: test compared AltaCore's prior mixed-host setup to Redwood Dedicated under a steady workload; traces anonymized. I'll attach the benchmark CSV after redaction.

legal_bot: All clear to publish globally except APAC-tiered customers where additional consent was requested by AltaCore; they've restricted distribution to NA/EU only. We should add a distribution note on the case study page.

marco_design: Final assets uploaded: `design/marketing/altacore-hero.png`, `design/marketing/altacore-stats-slide.pdf`.

tori_cs: Customer signed off on the final copy and the social package. They asked we wait until Tue 9am PT to publish (aligned with their PR schedule).

iris_marketing: OK locking calendar: draft PR opened, tag reviewers. Internal review deadline Mon 3pm PT. Publish Tue 9am PT targeted. Thanks everyone 1 :party-parrot:.
